name: Vernal-Fathom
description: Dust finer than flour pools in the low places, swallowing craters to their rims. Nothing has disturbed solar wind erosion patterns in a million years, and the dust keeps its surface smooth as held breath.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
